title: Tech debt: lab is too big and hard to maintain
objective: Reduce ./lab file size and complexity by extracting all remaining inline subcommand handlers into standalone scripts, enforcing a maximum of 50 lines per handler in the main file. Target: ./lab under 400 lines, no single handler over 50 lines.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ADDENDUM (2026-10-26). After the refactor, every extracted lab handler is verified by the VM end-to-end run from ticket #35 (up, --unsafe-recurse write, stop/down). A handler is not done because --help prints or the script exits 0; the AC is the observed container/service/file effect.
